content:
Optimism's development today focused on significant infrastructure enhancements, including `proxyd` metrics for improved SLOs and `bailiff` security upgrades, alongside core protocol advancements like enabling Super Root Games migration by default and resolving critical `op-node` and `op-reth` stability issues. Ongoing discussions continue regarding `PreimageOracle` gas reserves for the Glamsterdam upgrade and persistent flakiness in `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync` tests, which appear to stem from `op-reth` peer-management defects.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - `Precompile Gas Reservation for Glamsterdam (EIP-8037)` ([#19380](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19380)): Discussion is needed to determine if this issue should be closed as stale or redefined with an updated gas value to guarantee whole-function success.
    - `Flaky Test Investigation: TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync` ([#21041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21041)): Further investigation is required into the EL peer-management defect in `op-reth` causing backfill stalls.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Core Protocol & Stability Enhancements
- Enabled `SUPER_ROOT_GAMES_MIGRATION` by default in Foundry test configurations, adding an explicit opt-out row to the contracts feature matrix ([#21689](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21689)).
- Fixed `op-node` to reject stale sequencer build starts, resolving a flaky test related to `TestSupernodeLightSequencerInteropInvalidMessageReplacement` ([#21913](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21913)).
- Ensured `op-supernode` fails startup if the deny list cannot be opened, improving robustness ([#21997](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21997)).

### Infrastructure & RPC Tooling Improvements
- Added per-RPC-call metrics (`proxyd_rpc_calls_total`) to `proxyd` for detailed usage and error rate tracking, crucial for SLO monitoring ([#676](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/676)).
- Migrated `bailiff` Dockerfile from Alpine to `chainguard/wolfi-base:latest` for enhanced security ([#675](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/675)).
- Updated CI factory pins to the latest `main` commit for `build-images.yaml` and `build-images.apko.yaml` workflows ([#677](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/677)).
- `op-reth` now forwards `eth_getBlockReceipts` to its historical endpoint, enhancing RPC functionality ([#21955](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21955)).
- Pinned `op-reth` runtime base by digest and removed `strace`, streamlining the build process ([#22045](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22045)).
- Removed stale TODO references related to issue #20912 from `op-deployer` and bumped `OPContractsManagerV2` ([#22044](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22044)).

### Documentation & CI/CD Refinements
- Updated public documentation by single-sourcing governance treasury addresses ([#22008](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22008)), adding a "Get Started" home tab ([#22024](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22024)), archiving five stale notice pages ([#22050](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22050)), and renaming the "OP Stack" tab to "Protocol" ([#22038](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22038)).
- Fixed a CI `apko` factory pin issue to include `cargo-profile` input ([#22046](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22046)).
- Allowed uppercase letters in PR title scopes within CI ([#22035](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22035)).
- Updated the `superchain-registry` submodule in `superchain-ops` to reflect changes past the `sepolia-dev-0` removal, fixing a CircleCI job failure ([#1508](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1508)).
- Removed the `sepolia-dev-0` chain and its associated configurations from the `superchain-registry`, streamlining configurations ([#1294](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1294)).

## 🏗️ Work in Progress
### New Pull Requests
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - `op-reth`:
        - `feat(op-reth): bound validator resync/reorg wait in proofs e2e tests` ([#22056](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22056))
        - `feat(op-reth): make forwarded txpool admission opt-in` ([#22053](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22053))
        - `feat(op-reth): export OpLocalPayloadAttributesBuilder` ([#22043](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22043))
    - `op-devstack`:
        - `feat(op-devstack): wait for destination chain before sending executing messages` ([#22055](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22055))
        - `feat(op-devstack): use mutual trusted EL peering to survive peer drops` ([#22052](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22052))
    - CI/CD:
        - `chore(deps): bump github.com/quic-go/webtransport-go from 0.6.0 to 0.7.0` ([#22049](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22049))
        - `chore(ci): bump factory pins to latest main` ([#22047](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22047))
        - `chore(ci): rust fast linker` ([#22042](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22042))
        - `chore(ci): rust split builds` ([#22041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22041))
        - `chore(ci): rust sccache testing` ([#22040](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22040))
        - `chore(ci): rust sccache` ([#22039](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22039))
    - Other:
        - `chore(op-deployer): cherry-pick to activate karst at genesis by default` ([#22048](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22048))
        - `docs: application-facing OP Enterprise callouts` ([#22037](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22037))
        - `feat(op-supernode): rewind interop accepted state on L2 safe head reorgs` ([#22036](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22036))

### Active Discussions
- **ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry**:
    - `Precompile Gas Reservation for Glamsterdam (EIP-8037)` ([#19380](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19380)): Discussion on the sufficiency of `PRECOMPILE_CALL_RESERVED_GAS` for whole-function completion.
    - `Flaky Test Investigation: TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync` ([#21041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21041)): Investigation into EL peer-management defects causing `op-reth` backfill stalls.
- **ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops**:
    - `Precompile Gas Cost for Glamsterdam (EIP-8037)` ([#19380](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19380)): Ongoing discussion about `PRECOMPILE_CALL_RESERVED_GAS` and its implications for Glamsterdam.
    - `Flaky Test: TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync Family` ([#21041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21041)): Continued investigation into `op-reth` Engine API stalls and EL peer-management defects.
- **ethereum-optimism/infra**:
    - `PreimageOracle Gas Reserve for Glamsterdam Upgrade` ([#19380](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19380)): Discussion on the adequacy of `PRECOMPILE_CALL_RESERVED_GAS` for the Glamsterdam upgrade.
    - `Flaky Test: TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync Regression` ([#21041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/21041)): Further investigation into the `op-reth` EL peer-management defect.
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - `PreimageOracle Gas Reservation for Glamsterdam` ([#19380](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19380)): Discussion on the `PRECOMPILE_CALL_RESERVED_GAS` value for Glamsterdam.
    - `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync` Flakiness ([#21041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21041)): Continued investigation into `op-reth` EL peer-management defects.

## 🐞 Issue Triage
### New Issues
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - `Proposer should read DGF address from superchain registry for standard networks` ([#22051](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22051)): New issue to auto-configure the proposer using a `--network` flag.

### Closed Issues
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - `Add starting anchor root and prestate hashes to deploy input` ([#20912](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20912)): Resolved by removing stale TODO references in `op-deployer`.
    - `Missing eth_getBlockReceipts from list of forwarded RPCs for historical endpoint` ([#21031](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21031)): Fixed, ensuring `eth_getBlockReceipts` is correctly handled by the historical RPC endpoint.
    - `Flaky TestSupernodeLightSequencerInteropInvalidMessageReplacement` ([#21635](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21635)): Resolved by fixing `op-node` to reject stale sequencer build starts.

## ✨ Contributor Spotlight
- **joshklop** (ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry, ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops, ethereum-optimism/infra, ethereum-optimism/optimism): Provided critical analysis and recommendations on the `PreimageOracle` gas reservation issue for Glamsterdam across multiple repositories, guiding future action.
- **pauldowman** (ethereum-optimism/infra, ethereum-optimism/optimism): Contributed to the ongoing investigation of the `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync` flakiness, providing insights into `op-reth` Engine API stalls and EL peer-management defects.
- **clabby** (ethereum-optimism/optimism): Made significant contributions to core protocol enhancements by enabling `SUPER_ROOT_GAMES_MIGRATION` by default and fixing a critical `op-node` issue related to stale sequencer build starts.
